integrity.proof_method: Explicit global mutually inverse affine support-weight maps, valid for every finite group and finite transitive source set.

scientific_limitations: The classification requires transitivity of the source group action and simple complete graphs. It does not cover intransitive source actions or arbitrary graphs, or classify full equivariant homotopy types. Publication priority is not independently established.
title: Transitive diagonal fixed points of complete-graph Hom complexes
